summary: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. filed an 8-K on June 23, 2026, disclosing that Coffee Operating Unit head Rafa Oliveira will depart at end of July 2026 for an external CEO role. CEO Tim Cofer will temporarily oversee the coffee business while the Board searches for a CEO of Global Coffee Co., a standalone entity expected from the previously-announced separation of KDP's coffee and beverage businesses. The filing also reaffirms 2026 guidance. No deal terms were provided. This event updates the progress of a planned spin-off, announced earlier, which is the core special situation. The filing does not trigger a new deal category but supports the existing spin-off classification. Watch for further separation details and CEO appointment timeline.
